svg.title: Choosing a Deployment Type
svg.desc: Question one, where is data processed: Global, any region; Data Zone, stays in the EU or the US; Standard or Regional, one geography. Question two, how do you pay: Standard, pay per token; Provisioned, reserved throughput with lower latency variance; Batch, asynchronous, 50% off with a 24-hour target. The two answers combine into the deployment type: for example an EU retailer's live chat is Data Zone plus Standard, so Data Zone Standard, and its nightly job is Data Zone Batch. Watch the names: Global Standard is the default, Standard alone is not Global Standard, and Developer is only for testing fine-tuned models.
svg.text: Two questions: where may data be processed, and how will you pay? The answers name the type.
Stays in the EU or the US
Deployment type = where + how you pay
Data Zone + Standard = Data Zone Standard (EU live chat). Data Zone + Batch = Data Zone Batch (nightly job).
Global Standard is the default. "Standard" alone is not Global Standard. Developer is only for testing
